---
title: "sblrbench"
description: "Reproducible benchmark contracts and frozen development studies for sblr."
---

`sblrbench` provides reusable contracts, validation, metrics, provenance and
reproducible benchmark studies for scalable Bayesian linear regression methods
implemented in `sblr`.

## Current benchmarks

| Study | Purpose | Development status | Scale | Report |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Study 01 | Separated-locus fine-mapping | Complete current benchmark | 10 replicates; 40 fits | [Fine-mapping](studies/01_finemapping/report.qmd) |
| Study 02 | Held-out single-trait prediction | Complete current benchmark | 2 architectures; 5 replicates; 40 fits | [Prediction](studies/02_prediction/report.qmd) |
| Study 03 | Single-trait parameter estimation | Complete current benchmark | 2 architectures; 5 replicates; 40 fits | [Parameter estimation](studies/03_parameter_estimation/report.qmd) |
| Study 04 | Multichain convergence diagnostics | Current selection plus five-replicate validation | 4 selection fits/16 chains; 20 validation fits/80 chains | [Convergence](studies/04_convergence/report.qmd) |
| Study 05 | LD-operator validation | Complete integrated retained-low-rank and SBayesR LD-sensitivity validation | 2 architectures; 5 paired replicates; 60 four-chain fits plus one focused SBayesR window | [LD-operator validation](studies/05_ld_operator/report.qmd) |
| Study 06 | Annotation-informed models | **In development**; prespecified convergence stop reached | 2 maximum-history fits; no scientific benchmark | [Development status](studies/06_annotation_models/annotation-convergence.qmd) |
| Study 07 | Multitrait validation | **In development** | Planned/paused | [Study catalogue](studies/index.qmd) |

::: {.callout-warning .callout-development}
## Development benchmarks—not final method-performance claims.
These studies validate software workflows, reporting contracts and operational
diagnostics. Their short MCMC settings and limited simulation designs do not
establish universal rankings, calibration or production readiness.
:::

Continue with the [benchmark catalogue](studies/index.qmd), [framework](framework.qmd),
[metric definitions](metrics.qmd), or [reproducibility lifecycle](reproducibility.qmd).
